legacy_root.method: Materialize a 12-item labelled planted set (6 true / 6 false, form-matched pairs). Build one canonical JSON payload without labels. Copy those exact bytes to both vendor payload files, hash them, and subprocess confirm.py prompt-by-file with --ignore-user-config and no --background. Score each vendor against the mutation oracle: false-pass = CONFIRMED on planted-false; false-alarm = REFUTED on planted-true. Re-dispatch shuffled order per vendor and require identical rates. Inject 429 and severed-stream and require they do not become REFUTED.
legacy_root.question: Question: what are the per-vendor error rates on IDENTICAL planted inputs? Send the CNF-0133 planted set to both vendors with identical payloads and measure each vendor's false-pass and false-alarm rate separately. This is distinct from CNF-0155, which adjudicates live disagreements; this unit measures each vendor against known ground truth.
